cause: The generated program placed an order with subtotal 100 and required the returned total to be 120, but the pricing.rule component's apply-standard source says it adds a charge of 20 while its implementation adds only 2. Thus the computed total is 102, causing the order-total-mismatch explicit failure.
evidence: orders/place delegates to pricing.tax/add-standard, which delegates to pricing.rule/apply-standard after pricing.base/amount.
pricing.rule/apply-standard source documents a flat charge of 20 but implements (+ subtotal 2).
